thread:
cory_support: Heads-up — ACME ticket #7891. After yesterday's private rollout they report tool/function calls are returning with nested JSON fields flattened and some nested objects missing. Impacting tool invocation args (so functions either receive wrong keys or don't trigger). Reported after canary rollout of request-mapper changes. Pls triage, customer is blocked in production.

ben_ml: Can you paste a minimal before/after and any request IDs or traces? Also which model+variant were they hitting?

cory_support: Minimal repro from customer (redacted):
```
# pre-rollout request (expected)
{"action":"create_order","user":{"id":"u123","prefs":{"currency":"USD","locale":"en-US"}},"items":[{"sku":"x1","qty":2}]}

# post-rollout payload delivered to tool (actual)
{"action":"create_order","user_id":"u123","user_prefs_currency":"USD","items":[{"sku":"x1","qty":2}]}
```
They say `user.prefs.locale` is missing entirely and some nested maps are flattened into top-level keys with `user_prefs_` prefixes. Example request ids: abc-123, abc-124. Model: rwd-llm-2-small (hosted private variant).

dana_eng: Noted. Ops timeline shows `request-mapper-v2` was rolled as canary ~2057999800. Looks like a new flattening rule `transform.flatten_nested=true` was enabled by default in the new config. Assigning to eng-runtime to investigate behavior and whether mapper incorrectly applies to toolcall payloads vs metadata. @alicia can you grab traces and full proxy logs for abc-123/124?

alicia: I pulled traces from the proxy and the runtime. Trace IDs attached by ACME: trace-34a1, trace-34a2. Uploaded logs to the secure bucket: https://redwood.internal/logs/205799/trace-34a1 (ACME granted access). Quick grep shows the mapper emitted header `X-Transform:flattened` on those requests.

ops-bot: Deployment notice: request-mapper-v2 2057999000 -> 2057999999 rolled at 2057999800 by dana_eng (canary 30%).

eve_customer: Confirming — we saw ~42% of tool invocation failures for multi-field addresses and nested user prefs after the deploy. Example customer id cust-789, request abc-123 — tool was not invoked because `billing.address.location` path was flattened to `billing_address_location` and the function signature expects `billing.address`. This is high priority for us. Please escalate.

dana_eng: Understood — I'm scheduling an immediate rollback of the mapper config for the affected region and disabling the new `flatten_nested` flag for toolcall paths. Will post status updates. Thanks for the traces, @alicia. :construction_worker:
